title: Vilnius march and rally in solidarity with Ukraine on 24 February
reason: Actual public procession and rally are reported, but their stated purpose is solidarity with Ukraine and opposition to Russia/Putin, not a demand addressed to Lithuania’s own state. S003 reports anti-Russian slogans and Ukraine fundraising; no domestic policy demand is documented.

title: Farmers’ actions at dairy processor and supermarket headquarters
reason: LSM reports actions at private dairy-processor and shopping-center headquarters over low raw-milk prices. No simultaneous attendance threshold or demand directed to Lithuania’s own state is reported; keep separate from the Feb 24 Agriculture Ministry gathering.
